record.one_liner: AI-native CRM with a REST API, workspace API keys and a hosted MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Docs: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow for apps across multiple workspaces; workspace API key (access token from workspace settings Developers tab / app developer settings) for a single workspace. Hosted MCP uses OAuth.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed self_serve_free; help center says API key generation is 'Available on all plans', and the Free plan costs nothing for up to three users. Only SQL access via API/MCP is Ultra-only.
record.api_notes: critic: breadth moderate -> broad; public REST API covering records, lists, notes, tasks, webhooks etc. Rest-only per docs overview.
record.blocker_notes: Free plan admins can create workspace API keys immediately. Marketplace publication of multi-workspace OAuth apps goes through release approval, but that is not required to use the API.

evidence.quote: By generating an API key for your workspace
Attio implements the standard OAuth 2.0 specification, using the Authorization Code Grant Flow
Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
The Free plan costs nothing for up to three users.
Attio MCP is Attio’s hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
Every plan includes the Attio MCP server
